digest.component_or_area: Module-size gate enforcement and codebase refactoring
propositions: Six target files in src/rebar range from 786–800 LOC and are at or above the hard 800-LOC module-size cap, blocking any edit without triggering CI failure.
The module-size gate in .github/module-size-limit.txt is locked and cannot be raised; contributors cannot modify the limit, forcing files to be split.

Splits must follow logical architectural boundaries and existing call-graph seams rather than mechanical line-count reduction, must create no file under 100 LOC, and must leave substantial headroom (target <= 720 LOC) to prevent recurrence.

Each split must preserve observable behavior; existing tests covering affected code must pass unmodified, and all moved symbols must be validated against reference sets via Serena and grep to catch Any-typed receivers and dynamic access.
_config_sources.py (791 LOC) is now uncovered after in-flight ticket masonic-abeyant-stagbeetle closed and should be included in scope as a genuine gap.
